archetype: Dark Museum Gallery with Earthy Handcrafted Warmth
visual_mood: Awwwards Site-of-the-Day level digital reliquary. Obsidian black gallery halls punctuated by spotlight beams, raw clay terracotta (#C86D51), deep indigo block-print blue (#1E2B37), antique brass gold (#D4AF37), and bone white linen (#F5F2EC). Museum curation meets tactile craft and mystery gacha mechanics.

headings.h1_scale: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-light tracking-tight leading-none
headings.rule: DO NOT use Inter or generic sans for headings. Use Cormorant Garamond or Bodoni Moda with tight letter-spacing for headlines.

colors.contrast_rules: Always ensure text contrast ratio is >= 4.5:1. Explicitly set text color on all hover states (e.g., hover:bg-amber-900/40 hover:text-amber-100). Never rely on default dark mode opacity.

visual_enhancers.spotlight_effect: Radial gradient masks mimicking ceiling spotlight beams over dark velvet walls (bg-[radial-gradient(ellipse_at_top,_var(--tw-gradient-stops))] from-amber-500/10 via-transparent to-transparent)
visual_enhancers.film_grain: CSS SVG grain noise overlay with opacity-20 for tactile analog feel across museum walls
visual_enhancers.gacha_silhouettes: Drop-shadow and brightness-0 invert filter effects for secret vault artwork hints with shimmering glowing outline on hover

layout_and_spacing.hero_section: Kinetic Hero with line-by-line masked text reveal, signature canvas backdrop, floating edition badges, season countdown timer, and Lenis momentum scroll trigger

grid_modes.mode_a_tetris_gallery: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 lg:gap-12 for showcasing Season 1 Kutch collection (Hero spotlight span-8, square artifact span-4, tall tapestry span-4 row-span-2)
grid_modes.mode_b_dashboard: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6 for Admin panel, Artist submissions, and Customer artifact vault

layout_and_spacing.navigation: Sticky glassmorphism header (z-50) with smolComp mark SVG favicon logo, Season badge, Nav links (Exhibition, Blind Box, Secret Vault, Timeless, Region Poll, Cart), and Role-Switch Auth quick actions

motion_and_libraries.lenis: Smooth momentum scrolling configured for fluid museum walk-through feel
motion_and_libraries.framer_motion: Staggered scroll reveals, tab transitions, modal scale-ups, blind box gacha shake & unlock animations
motion_and_libraries.icons: lucide-react or @phosphor-icons/react for clean tactile iconography

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure smolComp branding is consistent with Season 1 focus: Kutch, Gujarat, India.
Implement distinct routes/views for Customer, Artist, and Admin portals.
Include a dynamic blind-box gacha system with suspenseful unpacking animation.
Add test-id attributes to all interactive elements for test automation.
Support full Stripe test checkout flow with interactive modal, input validation, and successful purchase state.
Use Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling and Framer Motion for scroll-triggered entrance reveals.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
